findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_gpus" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Every GPU class in the current snapshot: VRAM, how many offers and which providers have it, the machine sizes (GPU counts) listed, and the cheapest on-demand an…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_offers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
